seoDescription: How long does a custom neon sign take? Learn the exact production stages, 48-hour QC testing, express air shipping timelines, and rush event planning rules.
summary: A custom LED neon sign takes 7 to 14 business days from mockup approval to delivery, broken into 3 to 5 business days for precision CNC fabrication and 3 to 8 business days for express air shipping. Commercial metal channel letters and lightboxes require 10 to 18 business days. Rush orders can be fast-tracked to 7 to 9 days at no extra fee when your event date is specified.

keyTakeaways: Standard custom LED neon signs take 7 to 14 business days door-to-door, comprising 3 to 5 business days for fabrication and 3 to 8 business days for tracked air transit.
The production clock begins only after the customer approves the digital vector mockup; mockups are delivered within 24 hours including weekends with unlimited free revisions.
Every sign undergoes a mandatory 48-hour continuous burn-in quality control test to eliminate voltage drops, solder cracks, and driver thermal failures prior to crating.
Rush orders can reach your doorstep in 7 to 9 business days; The Glownique prioritizes tight event schedules at no extra surcharge when the date is specified at checkout.
For weddings, trade shows, and retail grand openings, order 3 to 4 weeks in advance to allow comfortable buffer for unboxing, dimmer pairing, and backdrop mounting.
